title: Cytogenetics & Long-Read Genomics — Karyotypes, Dual-Fusion FISH, SNP Arrays & Nanopore

teenKit.tldr: Cytogenetics & Long-Read Genomics (Karyotypes, Dual-Fusion FISH, SNP Arrays & Nanopore): Structural and molecular resolution of human constitutional genomics using 550-band karyotypes, dual-fusion FISH, and SNP microarrays. Evaluates the diagnostic utility of Nanopore long-read sequencing.
teenKit.whyItMatters: Tracing the primary evidence behind Cytogenetics & Long-Read Genomics connects oncology breakthroughs directly to how we diagnose, test, and understand the real world.
keyTakeaways: Structural and molecular resolution of human constitutional genomics using 550-band karyotypes, dual-fusion FISH, and SNP microarrays.
